name: Choi Ji Yoon

tagline: Two-headed serpent spy - the agent who infiltrated the Asia Red Army and never stopped chasing its secrets.
summary: Choi Ji Yoon is a female Counter-Terrorist character (official description: 'Two-headed serpent spy') and Ritsuka's CT counterpart. An intelligence-bureau officer of the special forces, she went undercover inside the Asia Red Army; her cover was blown while she was reading the group's confidential files and she fled home, joining the Counter-Terrorists in the hope of one day recovering those documents. She is also the captain who leads players through the Rex basement in the Chaos chapter, and the heroine of Zombie Scenario Season 6's 'Episode Choi'.
story:
**Background.** A member of the special forces' intelligence bureau, Choi Ji Yoon was assigned to infiltrate a Terrorist group (the Asia Red Army, ARA). Another agent (Ritsuka) exposed her while she was looking through ARA's confidential documents, forcing her to flee back to her country. She then joined the Counter-Terrorists hoping to get her hands on those documents again.

**Zombie Scenario: Season 1 - Chaos.** Choi Ji Yoon appears as the troop captain who orders the rescue team to press into the Rex laboratory basement. According to signal corpsman Felix's diary, the government issued an urgent retreat order, but Captain Choi's behaviour changed when she learned the team's location: she cut communications with headquarters and asked the team to carry out an internal investigation of the laboratory complex - leaving Felix wondering what she was really trying to find.

**Z-VIRUS trailer.** She is shown investigating a lab when a Sting Finger attacks her from behind; fleeing, she encounters a Venom Guard and defends herself with an M32 MGL found on the ground.

**Zombie Scenario: Season 6 - Episode Choi.** Sent by the CIA to infiltrate the Asia Red Army for intelligence, she is discovered by Ritsuka and held hostage; another CIA agent, May, is dispatched to rescue her. The episode reveals that the ARA, led by Mr. X, is funded by Douglas Jacob to deploy a biological weapon that turns people into monsters and zombies. She also appears in Season 7's All-Out chapter.

**Family.** Her sister, a Female Researcher at the Rex Research Institute, turned into the Sting Finger zombie during the escape from the institute.
appearanceDescription: Short black hair tied up, bangs almost covering one eye, brown eyes; glasses, earrings, dark-blue coat with matching mini skirt, unbuttoned white shirt, silver watch, tights, black high heels; a blue butterfly tattoo on her left chest. (Selection icon and manhwa show brown hair; in-game model is dark blue.)
